messages:
maya: quick FYI - PR #462 introduced function-calling examples with JSON schema. Pulumi reported a parse failure for a nullable array example (tasks). can someone triage?

sam: which file/section?

maya: examples/structured-output.md -> the 'task_list' example. model returned `{"tasks": null}` and our SDK snippet validation rejects it locally. docs preview didn't catch it.

lin: yeah i've seen that pattern. schema shows `items: { ... }` but doesn't allow the array to be null. two ways to fix: make the schema "type": ["array","null"] or use `anyOf`/`oneOf` for nullability. also update code snippets to show nullable types.

zach: i can push a tiny docs patch to change the schema to allow null arrays and add a 1-line note about null vs empty array.

sam: SDK owners: we need the generated snippets to match. python should be `Optional[List[Task]]`; TS should be `tasks?: Task[] | null`. can someone update generator templates?

alex: I'll coordinate the docs text + changelog link once SDK side is merged. Also add a short migration note under "Parsing gotchas" with a fallback example.

docs-bot: CI: docs-preview for PR #462 failed - broken-example-check. logs: https://ci.redwood.example/462/build/12

lin: once SDK PR merges, i'll re-run local parse tests against updated schema/examples.

zach: also proposing a tiny fallback snippet in the docs: `parsed.tasks = parsed.tasks ?? []` so users have a quick workaround.

maya: plan: SDK patch -> docs schema tweak -> local parse run -> docs migration note + link -> close issue. assigning follow-up issue #489 to track. thanks all :thumbsup:
